what_happened: Style/layout 6 (over-the-range microwave above an electric range, left-hinged door; same as success s19 and failure s16). Stage 0: onion grasped at 117, released into the black bowl at 253, stage 0 at 254. Stage 1: bowl grasped at 339 (the onion touches the fingers during the carry, packet 'holds' 321-358 and 451-627), released inside at 632, stage 1 at 646 (392 steps). Stage 2: the gripper swept the door from its free edge 744-832; closedness 0.03 -> 0.20 (752) -> 0.53 (800) -> 0.85 (832), and the door stopped there, ~15% open, with a small gap at its free edge next to the keypad. The policy treated the door as closed and went straight to the keypad: it pressed START at ~848 (turned_on 0 -> 1 at 848; the env lets the microwave turn on whenever the door is less than 90% open), but success needs the door shut (closedness >= 0.995). It then kept pressing around the bottom of the keypad (contacts almost continuous 864-1400), hit STOP/CLEAR at ~1232 (turned_on -> 0), and never went back to the door, which stayed at 0.85 to the end.
causal_chain: door swept to 0.85 closedness by 832 and left there -> start pressed at 848 with the door ajar (no success: door not closed) -> repeated keypad presses 864-1400, STOP pressed ~1232 -> door never pushed the last 15% -> fail
self_recovery: none for the door; it re-pressed the keypad for ~550 steps.
official_criterion_notes: The microwave's turned_on flag latches with the door 15% open (update_state only blocks turn-on when the door is >= 90% open), so the packet shows the microwave 'on' 848-1232 while stage 2 never held. Success correctly required the door closed. From the agent view the door looks almost shut; the gap is only visible at its free edge.
uncertain_about: Why the door stopped at 0.85 (the gripper left the door as soon as it was mostly closed; I saw no obstruction, but the bowl's exact position relative to the door is not visible through the dark glass).
